thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: High 5xx spike for hosted inference (inference-edge-us-east). Alerts triggered at 23:12 UTC — ~30% of gen requests returning 503s. See runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx. @devon (oncall) you're up.

devon (oncall): Ack. I'm on it, looking into autoscaler / nginx pools. grabbing logs now.

samir (sre): Seeing abnormal queue depth on rtx-pool-3 and a bunch of KV cache thrashing. Could be kernel-level GPU OOMs or proxy overload.

devon (oncall): Rolling a temporary routing change: send new incoming traffic to inference-edge-us-west while we triage. Will gate with 20% to start.

incident-bot: ACTION: routing-change applied by devon — 20% west, 80% east. Monitoring error rate.

ashley (support): Heads-up to support triage: some customers on hosted tier reporting timeouts. Any ETA? need to prepare proactive notices.

devon (oncall): No ETA yet. Mitigation path: scale rtx-pool-3 + restart proxy workers + enable fallback routing. Doing scale now: `infra scale gpu rtx-pool-3 +4`

samir (sre): Restarting proxy workers one at a time to avoid thundering herd. Patch rolling. If that doesn't bring errors down in 10m we revert to west routing 50%.

ops-bot: METRIC ALERT: 5xx-rate on inference-edge-us-east down from 30% -> 12% after probe, latency still elevated.

devon (oncall): Errors down to ~8% after scaling. Latency 200ms higher on some models. Observability suggests KV cache warmup.

ashley (support): Can we get an impact list for billing? Need to know which customers exceeded error thresholds and for how long — customers will ask about credits.

lia (billing): Copy. To assess reimbursement / SLA credit eligibility we need: customer_id, start_ts, end_ts, impacted_routes, estimated error_pct. CSV format please.

devon (oncall): Generating impact export now. Command: `scripts/impact-export --since 2026-03-14T23:10Z --until 2026-03-15T00:20Z --service hosted-api --filter 5xx`

samir (sre): One quick note on root cause: we've got a spike of malformed long-context requests that expanded KV usage and pushed cache eviction rates high. Longer-term fix: throttle prefix KV allocations and add guardrails in the runtime.

joel (product): For customer comms, prefer transparent but concise. Propose two templates: (1) high-impact customers (paid commitments) personalized and (2) generic status page / bulk notice. I'll draft.

devon (oncall): Drafting status page update — short and factual.

devon (oncall): STATUS PAGE DRAFT: "We experienced elevated 5xx errors for the Hosted Inference API in US-East between 23:12 and 23:49 UTC, impacting a subset of requests and causing increased latency for some models. We mitigated the issue by routing traffic to an alternate region, scaling GPU pools, and restarting proxy workers. Root cause under investigation — appears related to cache pressure from long-context requests. We're assessing customer impact and will follow up with any eligible account credits. (2026-03-15T00:10Z)"

joel (product): LGTM. Shorten second sentence slightly. Add a line about next steps: remediation plan and post-incident report ETA (48h).

devon (oncall): Updated status page copy: "... Root cause under investigation; remediation planned and a post-incident analysis will be available within 48 hours."

ashley (support): Customer-facing email draft for affected customers? Here's a start: "We're sorry — between 23:12–23:49 UTC some API requests failed. We've mitigated and restored service. If you experienced errors, we'll evaluate credits where eligible and follow up with a detailed report." Should we include instructions for customers to request detailed logs?

lia (billing): Please do not promise credits in the initial bulk email. Indicate we are evaluating eligibility and will follow up. For customers asking for credits now, support can escalate to billing with the CSV.

devon (oncall): Understood. I'm attaching the preliminary impact CSV in #private-billing (will send link). Summary: 42 accounts saw >0.5% error increase; 7 accounts had >5% sustained errors for >20min.

samir (sre): Adding runbook follow-ups: 1) throttle long-context requests at edge, 2) add eviction metrics alert, 3) add guardrail to model config. Will file follow-up tickets.

ashley (support): I'll push the bulk customer note now (no credits promised). For the 7 high-impact customers we'll prepare personalized messages and have billing prepped.

lia (billing): Once you send the CSV link, I'll pull the impacted account list and prepare credits calc. We'll follow the SLA policy: assess service-level by account SLA window and apply pro-rated credits where threshold met. I'll post template credit calculations to this thread.

devon (oncall): Quick timeline: mitigation completed and majority traffic healthy by 23:49 UTC. Final verification check at 00:10 UTC. I'll open the postmortem and link here.

ops-bot: NOTE: Postmortem created: https://redwood/incidents/2312345678-postmortem — assigned to samir.

lia (billing): Sample calculation template I'm going to use (will share as CSV later): `account,impact_start,impact_end,total_hours_impacted,credit_pct,credit_amount_usd`. Using our standard formula: credit = committed_monthly_fee * (downtime_hours / total_hours_in_month) * credit_pct.

joel (product): For internal comms to executives: short bullet summary only. Devon, can you pls DM the exec update once the postmortem is linked?

devon (oncall): Will do.

ashley (support): Closing notes: bulk customer notice posted to status page and emailed. Support triage queue flagged accounts that request credits and escalations.

lia (billing): Billing has the CSV and will send initial credit estimates to support within 2 business hours.

samir (sre): Filing three follow-ups and tagging infra, runtime, and api-proxy.

devon (oncall): Final quick checklist before I sign off: confirm postmortem link in thread, confirm billing received CSV, and confirm support has list of 7 high-impact customers for personalized outreach.

lia (billing): Confirmed — we have CSV and started calculations.

ashley (support): Confirmed — support has list and template personalized emails ready.

devon (oncall): OK thanks team. Handing to postmortem owners and billing. Marking thread resolved for paging purposes. :white_check_mark:
